outcome: Incidence of red blood cell transfusion
cohort: 23,456 parturients who delivered a live or stillbirth
finding: The incidence of red blood cell transfusion was 3.2% with major indications being anemia in pregnancy and postpartum hemorrhage, and transfusion being more frequent in cesarean births.
mod_finding: Transfusion was more frequently associated with caesarean than vaginal births (4.9% vs. 2.4%).
